prefixGrammarHint.separableRule: In Präsens and Präteritum, separable prefixes move to the very end of the clause.
prefixGrammarHint.inseparableRule: Inseparable prefixes (be-, ge-, er-, ver-, zer-, ent-, emp-, miss-) never separate from the verb stem.
prefixGrammarHint.dualRule: Prefixes like über-, um-, unter-, durch- can be separable or inseparable depending on the verb meaning.

conjugationGrammarHint.eToIRule: e → i vowel change in 2nd and 3rd person singular (du, er/sie/es).
conjugationGrammarHint.eToIeRule: e → ie vowel change in 2nd and 3rd person singular (du, er/sie/es).
conjugationGrammarHint.aToAeRule: a → ä vowel change in 2nd and 3rd person singular (du, er/sie/es).
conjugationGrammarHint.auToAeuRule: au → äu vowel change in 2nd and 3rd person singular (du, er/sie/es).
